attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to enumerate Active Directory.
description: An LDAP search query that collects information about administrators was executed. This may be indicative of Active Directory domain enumeration, which can be used to perform attacks against the organization.
investigative_actions: Check if the process executes LDAP search queries as part of its normal behavior. Investigate the LDAP search query for any suspicious indicators.
name: Administrator groups enumerated via LDAP
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
